blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Visual grounding localizes an object described by language with a bounding box. Most multimodal grounding models compress target identification, spatial reasoning, and boundary estimation into one terminal prediction. Free-form rationales make reasoning linguistically explicit but do not necessarily expose measurable, editable spatial states. Intermediate localization errors are therefore difficult to diagnose and correct, allowing incorrect region choices and imprecise boundaries to persist in the final box.
We introduce CoEvolve , a construct-to-edit framework that separates grounding into explicit state construction and state editing. Region-Evolution Reinforcement (RER) organizes grounding analysis into a progressive semantic–spatial trajectory, with each reasoning step committing to an explicit candidate region. Bidirectional Denoising Refiner (BDR) treats the reasoning text as fixed semantic context and refines the trajectory’s coordinate fields through bidirectional same-position reconstruction. Geometry- and behavior-level objectives provide target geometry and edit-preference signals for consolidating reliable candidates, preserving accurate inputs, or correcting toward annotations.
Evaluations cover natural-image and remote-sensing grounding. With a 9B backbone, CoEvolve rivals models up to 241B parameters in grounding accuracy. Under controlled corruption, a single BDR pass improves mean box overlap by over 27 percentage points, demonstrating strong recovery from substantial localization errors. State-source comparisons further support the complementarity of explicit state construction and source-matched editing. The project is at https://sundongwei.github.io/CoEvolve_Project/ .

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Visual grounding, or referring expression comprehension, localizes a language-described object with a bounding box. The field has progressed from proposal-based and modular grounding ( Kazemzadeh et al., 2014 ; Mao et al., 2016 ; Yu et al., 2016 ; Yu et al., 2018 ; Zhang et al., 2018 ; Liu et al., 2019b ; Yang et al., 2019 ; Liu et al., 2019a ) to end-to-end Transformers and grounded pre-training ( Deng et al., 2021 ; Kamath et al., 2021 ; Li et al., 2022 ; Yan et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2023 ) , and more recently to multimodal large language models (MLLMs) that unify language understanding and coordinate generation ( You et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024a ; Wang et al., 2024b ; Bai et al., 2025a ; Bai et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2024 ) . Despite stronger semantic representations, most approaches still compress target disambiguation, spatial search, and boundary estimation into one terminal box. Without an explicit spatial state for inspection and repair, errors in region selection and boundary estimation can persist into the final prediction.
blocks.zh: 视觉定位,或引用表达式理解,将语言描述对象本地化,并带有边框。 本领域从基于提案和模块的地面(Kazemzadeh等人,2014年;Mao等人,2016年;Yu等人,2016年;Yu等人,2018年;Zhang等人,2018年;Liu等人,2019年b;Yang等人,2019年a);Liu等人,2019年a)发展到端对端变换器和基础前培训(Deng等人,2021年;Kamath等人,2021年;Li等人,2022年;Yan等人,2023年;Liu等人,2024年;Wang等人,2023年),以及最近发展到多种模式的大型语言模式,统一语言理解和协调生成(You等人,2024年;Wang等人,2024年a; Wang等人,2024b;Bai等人,2025a;Bai等人,2025b;Wang等人,2025b;Wu等人,2024). 尽管语义表达更加强烈,但大多数方法仍然将目标分解,空间搜索和边界估计压缩成一个终端箱. 如果没有明确的检查和维修空间状态,区域选择和边界估计方面的错误就可能持续到最后预测阶段。

blocks.en: Reasoning-oriented systems expose rationales before spatial prediction ( DeepSeek-AI, 2025 ; Huang et al., 2026b ; Liu et al., 2025 ) , and grounded reasoning methods further pair language with explicit visual regions or coordinates ( Fan et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) . Iterative localization has also used reinforcement-guided region search ( Sun et al., 2021 ) , including anchor-guided reasoning in remote sensing ( Wang et al., 2026a ) . These advances motivate a further question: how can candidate target regions form a measurable state that is passed to an editor, so that coordinate changes can be evaluated against the observed state and accurate regions can be preserved?

blocks.en: We introduce CoEvolve , a construct-to-edit framework that separates grounding into explicit state construction and state editing, as illustrated in Fig. 1 . Region-Evolution Reinforcement (RER) externalizes otherwise free-form grounding analysis into a progressive semantic–spatial trajectory in which every reasoning step commits to an explicit region. Trajectory-level spatial rewards derived from terminal annotations adapt the model to this structured interface without human-authored reasoning chains or intermediate region labels. Bidirectional Denoising Refiner (BDR) retains the reasoning text as semantic context and edits the trajectory’s coordinate fields through bidirectional same-position reconstruction. Geometry-level supervision provides target geometry, while behavior-level supervision provides preferences for consolidating a reliable candidate, preserving an accurate input, or correcting toward the annotation.

blocks.en:
An outcome-only box reward does not directly assess whether intermediate region states make target-directed progress before the terminal prediction. RER therefore adapts an autoregressive policy π θ ​ ( y ∣ I , q ) \pi_{\theta}(y\mid I,q) to construct a measurable localization state. A valid response contains one <refine> block with 3 3 – 5 5 steps and one <answer> block. We denote its parsed sequence by τ ⁡ ( y ) \tau(y) , where each pair ( r k , 𝐛 k ) (r_{k},\mathbf{b}_{k}) associates a reasoning step with an explicit region and 𝐛 ans \mathbf{b}_{\mathrm{ans}} is the terminal answer. Unlike regions that identify visual evidence in grounded reasoning ( Fan et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) , each RER box is a candidate location for the referred target, and the ordered sequence becomes BDR’s editable state. We use semantic–spatial state to denote this division of roles: free-form text supplies semantic context, while each step exposes a spatial commitment evaluated by trajectory-level rewards. These rewards assess the spatial commitments rather than the semantic correctness of the free-form text itself.

blocks.en: The primary objectives operate inside a structured response whose reasoning and syntax must remain stable. General reconstruction ℒ gen \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{gen}} applies token cross-entropy outside the strongly supervised final digits; after warm-up, it preserves non-coordinate assistant content. Format loss ℒ fmt \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{fmt}} adds cross-entropy on structural tags and coordinate punctuation. For a digit distribution p p , natural entropy is H ( p ) = − ∑ d = 0 9 p ( d ) log p ( d ) H(p)=-\sum_{d=0}^{9}p(d)\log p(d) . The historical term ℋ hist \mathcal{H}_{\mathrm{hist}} sharpens digit distributions in earlier refinement steps without imposing an absolute coordinate target. The final term ℋ fin \mathcal{H}_{\mathrm{fin}} acts on the last Step and Answer only when the digit-vocabulary argmax equals the selected target digit, sharpening correct predictions without increasing confidence in an incorrect digit. These terms preserve response structure and non-coordinate content while regularizing confidence; they do not determine whether an edit is beneficial.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: We evaluate CoEvolve on standard referring-expression grounding, localization under stricter IoU criteria, controlled box correction, component ablation, and remote-sensing grounding. Unless otherwise noted, aggregate evaluation metrics are reported as percentages.
blocks.zh: 我们评价关于标准参考表达定位、更严格的IoU标准下本地化、控制箱校正、组件减速和遥感定位的欧洲委员会报告。 除非另有说明,总评价指标按百分比列报。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: For natural-image grounding, we train CoEvolve only on the RefCOCOg training set and evaluate all eight RefCOCO-family splits (57,457 examples) without further fine-tuning ( Mao et al., 2016 ; Yu et al., 2016 ) . RefCOCOg measures in-dataset performance, while RefCOCO and RefCOCO+ provide cross-dataset evaluation under RefCOCOg-only training. We report split-wise Acc ​ @ ​ 0.5 \mathrm{Acc}@0.5 and their arithmetic mean (Overall). Stricter-IoU, controlled-correction, and ablation experiments use five test splits comprising 30,969 examples. Unless stated otherwise, their aggregate metrics are computed jointly over all examples rather than by averaging the five split-level scores. Remote-sensing grounding is evaluated on DIOR-RSVG ( Zhan et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 就自然形象定位而言,我们只利用RefCOCOg培训集来培训CEvolve,并评估所有八个RefCOCO-Family分裂(57,457例),而不作进一步微调(Mao等人,2016年;Yu等人,2016年)。 RefCOCOg测量数据集中的性能,而RefCOCO和RefCOCO+则在RefCOCOg唯一的培训下提供跨数据集评价. 我们报告分为两个部分的Acc @ 0.5\mathrm{Acc\\\0.5及其算术平均值(Overall)。 更严格的IoU,可控校正,以及衰竭实验使用5个测试分数,包含30,969例. 除非另有说明,其总指标是在所有例子中共同计算的,而不是通过平均五个分级分数计算。 在DIOR-RSVG上评价遥感地面(Zhan等人,2023年)。

blocks.en: Grounding self-correction has been studied through iterative prompting and visual verification ( Liao et al., 2025 ) . We evaluate a trained coordinate editor on 30,969 examples using the same deterministic corrupted anchors for all methods. The anchors span multiple IoU levels and geometric perturbations and have 58.80% mIoU; Appendix D.4 gives the full construction protocol. This setting bypasses RER and directly evaluates end-to-end box correction under a shared corrupted-anchor protocol. BDR performs one same-position refinement pass, while the compared baselines generate corrected boxes from the same image, referring expression, and input anchor. Exact state templates, prompts, and parsing rules appear in Appendix B.6 .

blocks.zh: 4.5 国家建设和源头改造

blocks.en: Zero-Anchor BDR removes both the upstream localization hypothesis and the anchor-aware preservation and preference objectives enabled by that hypothesis, reducing training to direct same-position coordinate prediction. CoEvolve instead uses the RER state as both a localization starting point and an edit reference. Fig. 4 shows a 2.22-point mIoU gain, while the improvement grows from 2.19 points at Acc ​ @ ​ 0.5 \mathrm{Acc}@0.5 to 3.68 at Acc ​ @ ​ 0.7 \mathrm{Acc}@0.7 and 6.48 at Acc ​ @ ​ 0.9 \mathrm{Acc}@0.9 . This widening gap supports the joint value of a meaningful prior localization state and the anchor-aware objectives it enables. Appendix Table 10 reports split-level results.

Because both policies use the same response format, these gains show the benefit of RER training for structured region evolution. blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: CoEvolve reformulates visual grounding as a construct-to-edit process: RER externalizes measurable region commitments, and BDR refines their coordinates through bidirectional same-position reconstruction with geometry-level and behavior-level supervision. Experiments across natural images, controlled perturbations, and remote-sensing scenes support this decomposition. The state-source comparison further shows that refinement depends not only on initial localization quality, but also on how the editable state is constructed and how its editor is trained.
blocks.zh: ECEvolve重新将视觉定位作为构思到编辑的过程:RER将可计量的区域承诺外部化,BDR通过双向的同位置重建来完善坐标,并进行几何层面和行为层面的监督. 跨越自然图像的实验,可控扰动,以及遥感场景都支持这种分解. 州源比较进一步表明,完善不仅取决于初始本地化质量,还取决于可编辑状态的构建方式及其编辑人员的培训方式.

blocks.en:
CoEvolve is trained sequentially rather than end to end. We first optimize
RER on the RefCOCOg training set using the rewards defined below. After RER
training is complete, its adapter is frozen and used to generate one complete
localization response for each RefCOCOg training expression. Each saved record
pairs the original image and referring expression with the complete RER
assistant response and its annotated box. The generated RER responses are then
used to construct the BDR training set.

augmented with synchronized geometric perturbations, as detailed in

distribution and deliberately corrupted anchors. The annotation is retained
only for target construction and loss computation and is never inserted into

blocks.en:
RER adapts the backbone from terminal box generation to a structured interface
in which each reasoning Step exposes an explicit region. The terminal
annotation evaluates both the final answer and properties of the generated
trajectory, deriving trajectory-level spatial rewards from terminal annotations without
introducing manually labeled rationales or intermediate boxes. The resulting
response is therefore optimized as a localization state for subsequent
evaluation and editing, rather than as explanation text alone.

with probability 0.3 0.3 . The selected answer is replaced by a nonzero box
obtained through rejection sampling toward the configured IoU interval [ 0.2 , 0.5 ] [0.2,0.5] relative to the annotated box. The sampler uses translation, shrink, expansion, or random
geometry and rejects zero-area boxes; after 200 unsuccessful attempts it
uses bounded coordinate offsets. The answer, the last refinement box,
and earlier Steps whose IoU with the original answer exceeds 0.95 0.95 are
replaced together to preserve spatial consistency among the perturbed
coordinate fields.

performs a deterministic same-position pass on the current state. After each

state becomes the next-pass input. We use two BDR passes for all standard
natural-image and remote-sensing evaluations, providing a consistent
refinement budget across settings. Unparseable final <answer> boxes remain in the evaluation
denominator and receive zero IoU.

blocks.en: Appendix E Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录E 限制

blocks.en:
BDR improves correction behavior on average but does not guarantee an
improvement for every example. In controlled correction, refinement degrades 15.50 % 15.50\% of the anchors, compared with 11.42 % 11.42\% for Qwen3.5-9B.
Quality-gated targets encourage preservation of accurate inputs, but the
learned preserve-or-edit decision remains imperfect for a residual subset.
Calibrated edit acceptance, uncertainty-aware refinement, or adaptive stopping
could retain the current state when a further update is unlikely to help.
blocks.zh:
BDR 平均改善纠正行为,但不保证
每个例子都有改进。 在有控制的校正中,精度可降解15.50%的锚,而Quen3.5-9B的精度为11.42%。
质量目标鼓励保持准确的投入,但
知识丰富的保存或编辑决定对于剩余子集来说仍然是不完善的。
校准编辑接受度、不确定性意识改进或适应性停止
当进一步更新可能无济于事时,可以保留现状。

blocks.en:
The source-matched comparison shows that RER → \rightarrow BDR achieves stronger
final refinement than the separately trained native-output pipeline. This result
motivates further study of how state representations interact with their
corresponding editors, particularly across upstream model families and response
formats.
blocks.zh:
源码对比显示 RER ~\右旋 BDR 实现更强
最终的精炼,比单独训练的本土产出管道。 这个结果
促使人们进一步研究国家代表如何与它们互动。
对应编辑,特别是跨上游模范家庭和应对措施
格式。

blocks.en:
BDR treats reasoning text as fixed semantic context and edits the coordinate
fields of the localization state. This design keeps the semantic context fixed during position-aligned refinement, but semantic errors that cannot be resolved through coordinate correction remain outside the current editor’s scope. The current objective also does not
explicitly enforce semantic-role consistency between an earlier reasoning step
and its edited historical box. Extending bidirectional editing
toward jointly editable semantic–spatial states is a promising direction.
blocks.zh:
BDR 将推理文本视为固定语义上下文并编辑坐标
区域。 这种设计使语义上下文在位置对齐的修饰过程中保持固定,但无法通过坐标校正解决的语义错误仍然处于当前编辑器的范围之外. 目前的目标也没有
明确执行较早的推理步骤之间的语义作用一致性
及其编辑的历史盒。 扩展双向编辑
向可共同编辑的语义-空间状态发展是一个很有希望的方向。
